_comment: Data-driven REWARDED-AD HOOK config for Defenders of the Realm / Echoes of Elarion. Drives the thin AdGateService interpreter (WORK_ORDER_ad_generator.md §A). Owner data-first style: WHERE/WHEN an ad offer appears + WHAT it grants is DATA here, not hardcoded branches. The existing RewardedAdManager (Assets/_Modules/Village/Monetization/RewardedAdManager.cs) is the SDK seam (ShowAdInternal); this file replaces its single fixed 480s cooldown + implicit reward with a placement/reward TABLE. Devnet/stub-friendly: every reward resolves through existing services (EconomyService, OfflineHarvestService, BuildTimerService) so it runs end-to-end with the stub ad provider.

_sources.covenant: docs/monetization-v2-spec.md §5.3 — convenience is TIME-SAVING only, never combat-power; same covenant binds ad rewards
_sources.rewardSinks: Assets/Resources/Data/Canonical/packs.json economy block (glimmer/crystals/food/coins) — ad rewards draw from the SAME currency vocabulary

_schema.placement: { id (string, unique, stable key the call-site passes), enabled (bool), surface (enum: store|harvest|build|defeat|daily|tree), rewardId (FK->rewards[].id), cooldownSeconds (int, per-placement; overrides global), dailyCap (int, max grants/placement/local-day, 0=unlimited), requiresFlag (FeatureFlags name or empty), prompt { headline, body, cta } (localizable strings shown on the offer button/modal), priority (int, higher wins when two placements compete for one surface) }
_schema.reward: { id (string, unique), kind (enum: currency|timeskip|harvest|buff|cosmeticTrial), grant (object shaped by kind — see examples), description (string, player-facing), maxStack (int, how many unclaimed grants may queue, 0=apply-immediately) }
_schema.global: { defaultCooldownSeconds, hardDailyCap (sum across ALL placements), adProvider (stub|unityads|admob), respectDoNotSell (bool) }
